tools.name: quote
tools.description: What drawing one picture costs, in credits, and the quote_version to pass when creating it.

tools.name: status
tools.description: Call first. The signed-in workspace: its plan, credits left, drawings queued and running, and how many may queue.

tools.name: create_upload
tools.description: Start uploading a picture: answers an upload_url to PUT the bytes to, with the given headers. Then call create_drawing with the upload_id. Not needed when the host attaches the picture to create_drawing itself.

tools.name: create_drawing
tools.description: Draw a picture as a whiteboard animation. Spends credits (see quote). Answers at once with the drawing_id; the drawing takes a few minutes, follow it with get_drawing.

tools.name: get_drawing
tools.description: A drawing by id: its status and progress, its preview page, and once done the export options render_link accepts for it.

tools.name: list_drawings
tools.description: The latest drawings in the library, newest first.

tools.name: render_link
tools.description: One link that renders up to 20 of your drawings as files, each with its own choices (format, resolution, aspect, background, hand…; see get_drawing export_options). Opening it in a browser renders them one after another and saves each file to that browser’s downloads; drawings still being drawn are

tools.name: wait_render
tools.description: A render link’s files: each drawing’s state (pending, rendering, saved, failed) and, once saved, its file name and size in the browser’s downloads. Pass back the states of the last answer: it answers as soon as any of them moves on, or after about 50 seconds.

tools.name: wait_drawing
tools.description: For the drawing card: answers get_drawing as soon as the drawing moves on from the status and progress the card last showed, or after about 50 seconds.
